video_summary.overall_goal: User explores the BinaryEye barcode scanner app settings by opening the menu and navigating to the settings screen
video_summary.description: 15-second video showing user interaction with BinaryEye app: starting at scan screen, opening menu, and browsing through settings options

steps.what_screen_is_visible: BinaryEye main camera scan screen with title 'Scan code', dark theme, loading indicator (green circle) visible in center-bottom area
visible_ui_elements: Header with time 9:15 and status icons
Title text 'Scan code' at top left
Menu icon (three dots) at top right
Plus icon and other toolbar icons
steps.system_response: Screen remains on scan view, loading indicator visible
steps.intent_task: User is waiting at the scan screen

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Same scan screen, user hand now visible on right side of screen, appears to be reaching toward menu
steps.system_response: Hand appears on screen (physical interaction capture)
steps.intent_task: User preparing to interact with menu

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Menu dropdown opened showing options: 'Switch camera', 'Scan continuously', 'Restrict format', 'Find code', 'Settings', 'Info', 'Profile: Default'
visible_ui_elements: Menu options list with blue text on dark background
User hand still visible touching/pointing toward settings
steps.system_response: Menu dropdown appears with 7 visible options
steps.intent_task: User opens app menu to access settings

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Settings screen opened with 'Settings' header, 'Profile' section showing 'Profile Default', 'Scan' section showing 'Barcode formats' with detailed list of supported formats, and various toggles below
visible_ui_elements: Back arrow button at top left

Barcode formats expandable item showing: 'Aztec, Codabar, CODE 128, CODE 32, CODE 39 EXT, Code 39 Std, CODE 93, Data Bar, DATA BAR EXP STK, DATA BAR EXPANDED, DATA BAR OMN, DATA BAR STK, DATA MATRIX, DX FILM EDGE, EAN 13, EAN 8, ITF, MaxiCode, MICRO QR CODE, PDF 417, PZN, QR CODE, rMQR CODE, UPC A, UPC E'
steps.system_response: Settings screen navigates into view with details section
steps.intent_task: User navigates to settings to explore options

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Settings screen scrolled down, showing barcode format options, Show cropping limiter, Show crosshairs (disabled), Swipe up/down to zoom (enabled), Recognize vertical 1D barcodes (enabled), Optimize reader for accuracy (disabled), Scan continuously (disabled), Delay between continuous scans options
visible_ui_elements: All toggle switches with various states
steps.system_response: Content scrolls to reveal more options
steps.intent_task: User scrolls to see more settings options

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Settings page scrolled further, now showing mid-section options including various toggles for Show cropping limiter, Show crosshairs, Swipe up/down to zoom, Recognize vertical 1D barcodes, Optimize reader for accuracy, Scan continuously, Delay between continuous scans
visible_ui_elements: Same structure with slightly different portion of list visible
Back arrow and title still visible
steps.system_response: Additional options become visible through scrolling

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Settings continues to scroll showing more options: Show data in continuous mode (enabled), Vibrate on detection (enabled), Beep on detection (disabled), Beep tone (General beep), Beep audio stream, and more options below
visible_ui_elements: Multiple settings with icons on left, text, and toggles/values on right
steps.system_response: More settings options revealed, list scrolls continuously
steps.intent_task: User continues scrolling through all available settings

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Settings screen scrolled to show lower sections, displaying: Show metadata (enabled), Show hex dump (enabled), Show checksum (disabled), Show recreated barcode (enabled), Go back after copying or sharing (disabled), Open unknown data in (Always ask), Open unknown data with URL, Automated actions (No automated actions), Remove network suggestions (description visible), Generation section with Brighten screen (disabled), Language section with Custom language (Follow system settings)
visible_ui_elements: Back arrow still visible at top
Multiple toggle options with various states
steps.system_response: Scrolls to show final/lower settings options
steps.intent_task: User explores all available settings in the application

overall_flow: User starts at BinaryEye scan screen with loading indicator visible
User opens menu by tapping menu icon
User selects Settings from menu options
User scrolls through Settings screen multiple times to explore all available configuration options
Settings explore various categories: Profile, Scan formats, Display toggles, Notification settings, Data display options, and Language settings
human_readable_step_summary: App loads with scan screen displayed and loading indicator active
User hand visible preparing to interact with screen
Menu dropdown opens showing multiple app options including Settings
User taps Settings, navigating to the Settings screen showing Profile and Barcode format options
User scrolls down to view more scan-related settings (cropping limiter, crosshairs, zoom, 1D barcodes, accuracy optimization)
User continues scrolling to see additional settings in the middle of the list
User scrolls further to view notification and audio settings (vibration, beep, beep tone, audio stream)
User scrolls to bottom of Settings showing metadata, hex dump, checksum, language, and generation options
